answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity in a collateral escrow and linking evidence of coordinated equivocation: when k identities equivocate together, the penalty scales as O(k²), not as k independent fines. Detection also triggers asymmetric depreciation, so losses compound across the swarm and impose an exponential multiplier on capital loss. A sonnet, a marble, and a tide may be unrelated, but identities sharing equivocation evidence are not.
